scope: Only Codex and Command Code reference profiles. Existing reports unchanged; public/read-only research only. No runtime, credentials, account queries, registration, installation, builds or commits.

current.connection: Already implemented: chooser browser sign-in → CodexOwnedLoginAdapter → narrow authenticated Core login backend → PKCE/callback → durable owned credential reference. Only Codex has a qualified login adapter registered.
current.credentialOwnership: Core owns refresh tokens and updates owned file; Host stores only owned-file/account reference and reads current access token/expiry through SecretStore. Active applied route bindings AND ownership registry gate Core refresh.
current.monitoring: Existing CodexQuotaAdapter directly reads WHAM using same current access token plus ChatGPT-Account-Id. Imported codex-access-snapshot is a separate nonrenewable credential kind. API keys never qualify this quota reader.
current.qualification: Existing integration is the reference, not missing implementation. This research does not add real-provider or product availability evidence.

preferredFlow.readiness: Existing qualified adapter; preserve and reuse.
preferredFlow.summary: Choose Codex → sign in through browser → save account; attach existing direct quota reader automatically. No client ID, cookie, extra monitoring key or CLI setup.
preferredFlow.resourceSelection: Show returned account identity; preserve stable local account by provider account ID. Verify selected account/workspace before replacing credentials.
preferredFlow.standaloneMonitoring: Direct quota reads do not require paid inference; a pure monitor account still needs an explicit owned-refresh lifecycle because current Core refresh requires applied route membership. Do not invent dummy inference routes.

futureCandidates.state: Documented alternative integration; not current Lain backend.
futureCandidates.value: Official managed auth + account/rateLimits/read; investigate isolated storage/process adapter without stealing global CLI auth.

futureCandidates.state: New public candidate, not migrated/qualified in Lain.
futureCandidates.value: Dynamic own registration, public account model list and Responses inference. Separate Host-owned refresh; no manual maintainer registration shown in this specific OSS flow. No quota endpoint entitlement established by these docs.

userSteps: Choose Codex and browser sign-in (existing saved owned account can be reused).
Open the authorization action, sign in and choose the intended ChatGPT identity/workspace; return to Lain.
Lain adopts only its newly issued owned credential and reads available quota automatically. Saving login alone leaves inference unverified.
For an expired/revoked session use reconnect; preserve local identity/routes for the same verified provider account.

credentials.inference: Owned OAuth access token from Core; renewable grant stays in private owned-auth directory.
credentials.monitoring: Same current owned access token and account ID, no second key.
credentials.refresh: Core is single owner. Host quota reader never copies/rotates refresh tokens. Disabled, removed or unselected owned credentials are inert for Core.
credentials.externalSnapshot: Copy only access token/account ID/expiry from explicit supported import. Never source refresh/revoke or mutate external auth file. Expiry requires deliberate reimport/reconnect.
credentials.reconnect: Same verified provider account updates its owned reference; different identity must become a deliberate separate account. Cancellation must not overwrite active credentials.
credentials.disconnect: Current account removal is local configuration removal after detaching active routes; it retains private credentials. Pending-login cancellation is not logout or revocation. No implemented provider-wide logout claimed.

inference.current: Existing Codex Core transport and model routes; adopted account starts unverified. Model catalog/credential check is not completed inference proof.
inference.subscriptionVsApi: ChatGPT subscription and OpenAI Platform API-key billing are distinct. Manual API key is a separate account/product flow, not Codex subscription quota fallback.
inference.futurePreview: SIWC OSS tokens go to public api.openai.com/v1/responses with store:false, stream:true and account-available model. New audience/grant must not be fed automatically into existing backend-api transport or WHAM reader.

monitoring.current: GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/usage, Bearer + ChatGPT-Account-Id; primary/secondary used percentages and reset/window fields when present.
monitoring.meaning: Provider account windows, not local token counter or exact USD balance; unknown/missing fields stay unknown.
monitoring.publicAlternative: Codex app-server account/rateLimits/read documents multi-bucket rateLimitsByLimitId plus optional plan/credits metadata. Separate adapter candidate; not evidence that SIWC public Responses tokens can call this RPC/WHAM.
monitoring.recovery: Unauthorized/expired → reconnect state; monitor failure must not erase prior observations or claim inference failed. Preserve observation timestamp.
monitoring.standalone: No inference probe is required to read existing quota source. Route-independent owned refresh remains target work.

maintainerPrerequisites.existing: No new public app registration needed to use today’s shipped Core-owned login. Keep pinned Core/provider qualification and same-token boundaries.
maintainerPrerequisites.appServerCandidate: Package/version/isolate own app-server and prove managed lifecycle and per-account rate limits; no global ~/.codex login/logout manipulation.
maintainerPrerequisites.siwcOssCandidate: Implement documented dynamic registration, issued client mapping, PKCE/state/nonce/ID-token validation, explicit chatgpt.tokens.use.direct grant, secure serialized refresh and selected-session revoke. The documentation does not require a pre-obtained client secret/partner key for this OSS path. Check Preview eligibility/availability before promotion.

providers.product: Command Code CLI bootstrap + Provider API reference

current.connection: Manual API account/import supported; command-code/commandcode and official host normalize to commandcode. No Command Code IQualifiedLoginAdapter exists.
current.inference: Existing generic API-key route transport can use Command Code; transport name (Codex/OpenAI/Anthropic) does not define commercial provider identity.
current.monitoring: Existing CommandCodeQuotaAdapter uses same API key: required alpha/whoami?limits=1, then optional alpha/billing/credits and alpha/billing/subscriptions with returned org.id.
current.qualification: Implemented reader and existing key path; official CLI browser bootstrap is publicly documented, but Lain-owned bootstrap/adoption is not implemented or live-tested here.

preferredFlow.readiness: Reference target combines already existing reader/key integration with a small separately qualified official CLI bootstrap/adoption.
preferredFlow.summary: Choose Command Code → reuse selected existing key; otherwise official browser bootstrap → adopt only resulting Command Code API key → automatic same-key monitoring. No separate monitor login or user-entered OAuth app parameters.
preferredFlow.bootstrap: Official command-code login (cmd alias) opens browser and writes API key to its managed auth.json. This is a key-bootstrap result, not an OAuth refresh token grant owned by Lain.
preferredFlow.resourceSelection: Use already existing personal/organization workspace; show verified whoami organization. Require deliberate replacement if organization changes.
preferredFlow.standaloneMonitoring: Same-key direct reader can be offered without inference route/entitlement; a plan lacking Provider API inference access can still have monitoring rights if actual reporting reads succeed.
preferredFlow.qualificationBoundary: Do not claim arbitrary own OAuth client reuse; public quickstart alone does not establish third-party client registration or callback API contract.

userSteps: Choose Command Code and reuse a saved key if present.
For new access: complete official browser login through qualified CLI helper; review the detected account/organization and adopt its newly produced Command Code key.
If helper is unavailable, open Studio API Keys, select existing workspace, generate/copy key once into Lain.
Lain reads identity and available quota using that key; choose a supported model/route only when inference is wanted.

credentials.inference: Command Code API key; official Studio states same key authenticates CLI and Provider API.
credentials.monitoring: Same key in existing reader, no billing cookie/session or separate Admin key. Individual optional endpoints may still be forbidden.
credentials.refresh: No OAuth refresh token handling proven for the bootstrap API key. Do not invent token renewal; replace revoked/expired key deliberately.
credentials.bootstrapOwnership: Official CLI owns its login and auth cache. No automatic global cmd logout, overwriting CLI auth.json, environment credential harvesting or full mixed-provider file import. Use a bounded explicitly selected result with verified schema/identity; isolated helper directory only if supported and qualified.
credentials.reconnect: Replace credential on same account after whoami identity/org check; changing workspace means deliberate new identity/scope. Existing monitors remain stale until refreshed.
credentials.disconnect: Remove local Lain access without logging out the user’s CLI or revoking a shared key automatically. Offer Studio key management for deliberate revocation.

inference.authentication: Bearer API key; choose model-supported endpoint.
inference.rights: Official Provider docs: API access is plan-dependent (Go excluded in reviewed current page), model/credit access also varies. Login/key possession and quota success do not prove inference entitlement.
inference.noProvisioning: No automatic plan purchase, new organization or billing setup.

monitoring.type: Direct same-key provider reader, independent of local inference traffic.
monitoring.identity: whoami required; organization scope only from actual returned org.id. Then optional credits/subscriptions; partial failure stays partial.
monitoring.fields: Monthly/purchased/free USD credits; fiveHour/weekly rolling cap/used/reset; returned organization/model limit/spent/reset.
monitoring.knownLimit: Additional monthly per-model remaining is deliberately unknown in current code. Existing PlanCredits lookup is historical account-plan baseline, not authoritative live plan or per-model cap.
monitoring.contract: alpha endpoint behavior evidenced by current implementation; reviewed public Provider docs establish inference API/key reuse, not a public stable billing API contract.
monitoring.monitorOnly: Attach key to direct reporting without requiring inference route. Keep actual reporting permission/result separate from API plan eligibility.

maintainerPrerequisites.existing: No new OAuth registration for same-key reader/manual Provider API integration.
maintainerPrerequisites.bootstrapCandidate: Qualify official CLI executable/version, exact result schema, safe bounded adoption, cancellation, stale-cache avoidance and organization identity. Verify supported isolated storage if used.
maintainerPrerequisites.ownOAuth: Only if building an independent own browser protocol rather than using official CLI: obtain/verify provider contract and any own public app registration required. Do not invent or reuse a third-party client ID; normal user never enters client ID/secret.
maintainerPrerequisites.reader: Retain implemented same-key reader; improve explicit partial/unknown provenance instead of making extra credential setup mandatory.
